snippet.title: FIXKIN: A Long Way Home (at the End of the World) — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
See it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4107560

Set off on a journey home through a suddenly tech-free world. Use Leno’s rhythm-based FIXKIN skills to repair keepsakes for a colorful cast of characters, uncovering their stories along the way. A cozy narrative road trip about connection, healing, and the things worth mending.
